spans.s: अनेक a. 1. Not one, much, many, Kir.i.16; 2. more than one, अनेकपितृकाणां तु पितृतो भागकल्पना Yaj.ii.120; 3. separated.
अनेक-अक्षर a. consisting of more than one syllable.
अनेक-अच् a. having more than one vowel.
अनेक-अन्त (I) a. variable.
अनेक-अन्त (II) m. 1. want of permanency, unsettled condition; 2. uncertainty; 3. an unessential part, e.g. अनेकान्ता अनुबन्धाः ‘indicatory letters are not an essential part.’
अनेक-अन्त˚वाद m. scepticism.
अनेक-अन्त˚वादिन् m. a Jaina.
अनेक-अर्थ (I) m. multiplicity of objects or topics.
अनेक-अर्थ (II) a. 1. having more than one meaning, अनेकार्थस्य शब्दस्य K.Pr.ii.; 2. having the sense of the word अनेक.
अनेक-आश्रय m. dependence upon more than one, abiding in more than one.
अनेक-कालम् ind. for a long time.
अनेक-गोत्र m. a boy who belongs to two families, viz., to that of his own and to that of his adoptive father.
अनेक-ज (I) a. born more than once.
अनेक-ज (II) m. a bird.
अनेक-त्र ind. in various places.
अनेक-धा ind. 1. in various ways (रूपं) चक्षुषः सहकारि स्याच्छुक्लादिकमनेकधा; 2. often.
अनेक-प m. an elephant, मालवनाथोऽप्यनेकानेकपयूथसनाथः D.K.
अनेक-मुख a. 1. many-faced; 2. dispersed, going in various directions, बलानि जगाहिरेऽनेकमुखानि मार्गान् Bt.ii.54.
अनेक-रूप a. 1. multiform; 2. of various sorts; 3. fickle, of various nature, e.g. वारांगनेव नृपनीतिरनेकरूपा Bhartr.ii.
अनेक-लोचन m. 1. a name of Śiva; 2. of Indra.
अनेक-वचन n. the dual and plural numbers.
अनेक-वारम् ind. many times, frequently.
अनेक-विध a. of many kinds, various.
अनेक-शफ a. cloven-hoofed.
अनेक-शस् ind. 1. in various manners, अनेकशो निर्जितराजकस्त्वम् Bt.ii.52; 2. several times, frequently; 3. by large numbers or quantities, अनेकगोब्राह्मणमनुष्यवधान्मे पुत्रा अनेकशो मृता दाराश्च Hit.i.
अनेड m. A fool.
अनेडमूक a. (f. का) 1. Deaf and dumb, अनेडमूकताद्यैश्चद्यतु दोषौरसंमतान् K.Pr.vii. (Cf. एडमूक); 2. wicked, perverse; 3. blind.
अनेडमूक a. (f. का) 1. Deaf and dumb, अनेडमूकताद्यैश्चद्यतु दोषौरसंमतान् K.Pr.vii. (Cf. एडमूक); 2. wicked, perverse; 3. blind.
अनेनस् a. Sinless, faultless.
अनेहस् m. (nom. sing. अनेह) Time.
